claim_summary: For every connected simple trivalent unicyclic graph with \(n\ge3\) leaves, \(X(G)\) has exactly \(2^n\) binary torus fixed points and \(2^{n-1}\) all-half-cycle torus fixed points, and \(\chi_{\mathrm{top}}(X(G))=3\cdot2^{n-1}\).
integrity: Primary MSC and arXiv posting date checked against source; explicit published cone used; finite tests supplement, not replace, the symbolic proof.
limitations: Only connected simple trivalent unicyclic graphs over C; no higher-cycle, Betti-number, or singularity classification. The full-range assertion follows from proof, not finite enumeration. Literature search cannot establish absolute uniqueness.
title: Leaf-parity dichotomy for torus fixed points on unicyclic phylogenetic toric models
